raw_text: Notification: Annual Exercise Himgiri Prahar-2024 is scheduled from 08 March to 22 March 2024 in Ladakh region under HQ Northern Command. All stakeholders including state administration and border trade authorities are advised that enhanced military vehicle movement on NH-1D, Zoji La axis, and DBO road is expected during this period. This is a routine annual exercise and does not indicate any change in the security situation along the LAC.
clean_text: PIB notification: Exercise Himgiri Prahar-2024 scheduled 08-22 March 2024 in Ladakh under Northern Command. Enhanced military vehicle movement expected on NH-1D and DBO road. Routine annual exercise with no change in LAC security situation.
